name: Today’s Bookings
query:
SELECT
    meeting_title AS "Meeting Title:Data:200",
    room AS "Room:Link/Meeting Room:150",
    requested_by AS "Requested By:Link/Employee:150",
    booking_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    start_time AS "Start Time:Time:100",
    end_time AS "End Time:Time:100",
    status AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM `tabRoom Booking`
WHERE booking_date = CURDATE()
AND status = 'Approved'
ORDER BY start_time
